text: dsh-user-addons 为 DSH Web 增加文件拖放上传、归档会话搜索与预览、图像输入能力判断，以及本地模型和 token 用量面板。功能通过 Web composer、设置页和会话标题栏使用。 同时提供同源 HTTP 接口连接 Web 界面与本地工作区数据。 上传文件保存在本地目录。 可在设置中操作。

dsh-user-addons adds file drop uploads, archived session search and preview, image input capability detection, and a local model and token usage dashboard to DSH Web. Use its composer dock, settings sections, and session header pill. 同时提供同源 HTTP 接口连接 Web 界面与本地工作区数据。

Drop files into the DSH Web composer and attach them to a conversation.
Search archived conversations and preview their contents before restoring them.
View local token and model usage totals by day and session.
dsh-user-addons 的文件拖放上传功能：在 Web 对话输入区拖放或选择多个文件，上传后展示文件状态；图片按模型能力作为图像附件，其他文件以路径形式使用。
dsh-user-addons 的归档会话管理功能：在设置页搜索会话，查看预览并归档或恢复记录；列表通过工作区注册信息访问本地会话。
dsh-user-addons 的用量统计功能：读取本地会话日志，汇总模型、日期、会话的调用和 token 数，并在设置面板展示汇总及趋势。
dsh-user-addons 的今日用量提示：会话标题栏显示当天 token 和调用数，展开可查看模型用量摘要。
dsh-user-addons 的图片能力检测：客户端可查询当前会话模型是否支持图像输入，以选择附件处理方式。

dsh-user-addons README · dsh-user-addons：Community web add-ons for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

This package provides a small, out-of-tree DSH plugin with both Host and Web client halves. It does not modify DSH core files.
dsh-user-addons README · Interfaces：*(Interface sketch — layout and colour semantics only; all figures shown are illustrative placeholders, not real measurements.)*

dsh-user-addons README · Features：- File drop/upload support in the Web composer. Images are attached when the selected model supports image input; other files are saved locally and attached by path.
- An archived-session manager for finding, archiving, restoring — and since 1.3.0, previewing (read-only conversation peek without restoring) and full-text searching (matches inside the decoded conversation log, not just titles) — sessions through DSH's workspace registry.
- A local model and token usage dashboard, folded from `~/.dsh/sessions`.
- An image-capability endpoint used by the Web client to choose the appropriate attachment behavior.

dsh-user-addons README · Requirements：- A DSH Web profile with the client module loader enabled.
- Node.js 22.19 or newer, matching the current DSH development baseline.

dsh-user-addons README · Install：**This package is not published to npm.** There is no `@yur0918/dsh-user-addons`
on the registry — installing by package name will fail with a 404. It is a
**local profile plugin**, loaded by symlinking the source directory into the
profile's `node_modules` and inserting one row into the profile patch layer.

From a clone of this repository:

```bash
dsh-user-addons README · 1. symlink the package into the profile's node_modules：ln -s "$PWD" ~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules/dsh-user-addons
section: 1. symlink the package into the profile's node_modules

dsh-user-addons README · (append to ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml)：cat >> ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml <<'YAML'

- insert:

      name: 'dsh-user-addons'

dsh-user-addons README · Local routes：The Host half registers same-origin `/addons/*` routes:

- `GET /addons/health`
- `GET /addons/archive/list`
- `GET /addons/archive/preview`
- `POST /addons/archive/archive`
- `POST /addons/archive/restore`
- `GET /addons/image-capability`
- `POST /addons/upload`
- `GET /addons/usage/summary`

dsh-user-addons README · Local routes：Uploads are limited to 100 MiB (`UPLOAD_LIMIT_BYTES` in `lib/index.js`) and
filenames are sanitized before being written below the DSH home. Usage data is
read locally from DSH session logs; this plugin does not make network requests.

dsh-user-addons README · Development：The browser bundle in `lib/client.js` is intentionally committed because DSH's Web host serves built client bundles. Keep the Host and Client halves compatible with the DSH version you are using, and run `npm run check` before publishing.

Please do not commit session logs, uploaded files, credentials, generated task state, or backup files.
